## Overview

The manifesto sets long declarative lines on a black stage.

## Anti-slop Waivers

- waive 1 · --font-display and h1 use Inter · the manifesto headline is set in the grotesque the printed posters already use
- waive 27 · no reduced-motion block · the stage has no motion worth reducing anyway
- waive 64 · labels · design choice
- waive 54
